description: The workout plan transcribed from the sheet, exactly as written.

Name.description: A short name for the plan

Description.description: What the sheet says about the plan as a whole, or an empty string.

Sessions.description: An array of sessions to perform.

Name.description: The name of the session. This might relate to the day of the week, or the type of session (e.g. 'Legs').

Description.description: A description of the session. (e.g. 'A session to work the legs').

Exercises.description: An array of exercises to perform.

Sets.description: The number of sets to perform.

RepsPerSet.description: The number of reps to perform.  If the exercise is timed, this is the number of seconds to perform the exercise for.

WeightIncreaseOnSuccess.description: The weight increase the sheet states for completing all reps, or 0 when it states none.

Notes.description: The load and any other notes the sheet gives for this exercise (e.g. 20 kg, tempo 3-1-1), or an empty string.

RestBetweenSets.description: The rest time to use for the exercise.

MinRestSeconds.description: The minimum rest time to use for the exercise on successful completion of all reps

MaxRestSeconds.description: The maximum rest time to use for the exercise on successful completion of all reps.  It MUST be greater than MinRest

FailureRestSeconds.description: The rest time to use for the exercise on failure to complete all reps in the set. It MUST be greater than MaxRest
